WITH qualifying_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT catalog.department
    FROM main.major AS catalog
    WHERE catalog.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
)
SELECT
    catalog.department,
    COUNT(*) AS catalog_major_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN catalog.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 END) AS majors_in_college,
    COUNT(catalog.major_name) AS named_majors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog.major_name) AS distinct_major_names
FROM main.major AS catalog
WHERE catalog.department IN (SELECT department FROM qualifying_departments)
GROUP BY catalog.department
ORDER BY catalog.department

WITH members_per_major AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM main.member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
department_majors AS (
    SELECT
        catalog.department,
        catalog.major_name,
        catalog.college,
        COALESCE(roster.member_count, 0) AS member_count
    FROM main.major AS catalog
    LEFT JOIN members_per_major AS roster ON roster.major_id = catalog.major_id
    ORDER BY catalog.department, catalog.major_name, catalog.major_id
)
SELECT
    department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END, ', ') AS majors_held,
    ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM department_majors
GROUP BY department
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 END) > 0
ORDER BY department
LIMIT -1
